conditions.B: Same frozen 435-byte help recipe; guides/schemas retained

rationale: The primary configuration tasks require scope exclusions and intentional Other rules beyond the displayed recipe. Test the mechanism separately on a task whose syntax is covered by the example. Designed before primary aggregate results were inspected; primary gates remain unchanged.
sample_relation: Supplementary diagnostic, not pooled with the preregistered 24 runs and cannot override their adoption gate.
decision_rule: All treatment runs must pass. A simple-task efficiency signal requires at least 3 of 4 paired wins and either median agent calls at least 1 lower with median uncached input no more than 5% higher, or median uncached input at least 10% lower with median agent calls no higher. Report all resource metrics, retrieval routes and uncertainty.
design_basis: Recipe syntax coverage versus task requirements, not observed efficiency.
